'''2001 Tulsa Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open tournament held in Tulsa, Oklahoma, in 2001.<ref name="dt-16258">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16258 Shield Strike Team], DeckTech (Scott "tk424" Manley, 28 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16258/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16258/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 28 May)
* '''Site:''' Tulsa, Oklahoma
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Manley wrote that his Light Rebel Strike Team deck "went undefeated at the Tulsa Ok Open", after changes made on readers' tips.<ref name="dt-16258" />
